title.en: Drowned City Nerfs & Reduced Population in Zones - WoW: Forever Hotfixes for November 9th
title.es: Nerfs de la ciudad ahogados y población reducida en zonas - WoW: Forever Correcciones en Vivo (Hotfixes) para el 9 de noviembre

summary.en: Drowned City Nerfs & Reduced Population in Zones - WoW: Forever Hotfixes for November 9th...
summary.es: Drowned City Nerfs & Reduced Population in Zones - WoW: Forever Correcciones en Vivo (Hotfixes) para el 9 de noviembre...

contentHtml:
Blizzard has posted hotfixes for today, which includes many class bug fixes, a nerf to The Drowned City, and reducing the population in zones with significant population.
Blizzard
View Original

Hotfixes

November 9, 2026

Classes
  • Druid
    • The Cooldown Manager no longer shows Berserk, and now correctly shows Lacerate when learned.
    • Idol of Ferocity no longer lists Mangle as an ability it discounts.
    • Feral
      • Fixed an issue where Feral Charge (Cat) was not putting the Druid in combat right away.
      • Fixed an issue where Natural Instinct was not applying correctly to Lacerate or Pounce.
      • Fixed an issue where the Pounce Stun debuff was not showing in the enemy debuffs while active.
  • Hunter
    • Vulgara the Insatiable and the Shrieklings of Zephras should now belong to the correct hunter pet families.
    • Fixed an issue causing Hunters to sometimes aggro enemies from very far away by targeting them.
  • Mage
    • Flamestirke’s ticks on the ground no longer incorrectly consume clearcasting.
    • Arcane Concentration’s activation chance now correctly splits across the cast and every bolt (was granting 10% on cast and per bolt).
  • Paladin
    • Fixed an issue where Consecration could stop dealing increased damage to enemies if targets inside of the Consecration despawned previously.
    • Fixed an issue where Cooldown Manager wasn’t showing Seals correctly.
  • Priest
    • Shadowform no longer breaks when casting Fear Ward.
    • Power Infusion will now correctly persist when used on allies.
  • Shaman
    • Updated the visual effect for Lightning Mastery.
    • Lightning Overload now deals the correct amount of damage for Lightning Bolt.
    • Fixed an issue causing Improved Ghost Wolf to not hold the Night Watchman’s Torch in its mouth.
  • Warlock
    • Completing “Summon Felsteed” will correctly grant the player the appropriate riding skill.
      • Developers’ notes: If a player completed the quest before this hotfix, summoning the Felsteed once will grant them the apprentice riding skill, allowing them to ride other mounts if desired.
    • Fixed an issue allowing Incinerate to be available to non-Destruction specializations.
  • Warrior
    • Thunderclap no longer tracks its duration on the target via Cooldown Manager and now only shows its cooldown.
Dungeons
  • Experience rewarded for all enemy kills in dungeons increased by 50%.
  • Alcaz Prison
    • Defeating Zarla Ober will now drop loot.
  • Blackfathom Deeps
    • Fixed an issue that could cause players to become unable to release after dying in Blackfathom Deeps.
  • Blackrock Depths
    • Fixed an issue that prevented the throne room doors from opening if the party wiped while fighting Emperor Thaurissan.
    • Heart of the Mountain can now be looted more than once.
  • The Drowned City
    • Fixed an issue that was causing creatures inside the Drowned City to do about 30% more damage than intended.
    • Deathless Marrow
      • Lowered the health of the creatures in the Deathless Marrow encounter by 25%.
      • Lowered the damage of the Deathless Sorcerer’s Fireball by 25%.
      • Lowered the damage of the Deathless Watcher’s Charge by 50%.
      • Reduced the cast frequency of the Deathless Guardian’s Shield Slam ability by about 50%.
  • The Shaper’s Terrace
    • The Shaper’s Terrace: Vitrix, Snowtalon, and Cinder now correctly drop loot and higher-level skinning materials.
    • Cinder should now correctly spawn after players use the Archival Panel.
  • Stratholme
    • Fixed an issue that allowed players to mount inside Stratholme.
Enemies and NPCs
  • Silverpine Forest - Fixed an issue where Ivar the Foul was respawning more slowly than intended.
  • Teldrassil - Spawn time reduced for Ferocitas the Dream Eater.
  • Un’goro Crater - Fixed an issue that was causing Young Diemetradons to spawn at level 58 (rather than 51 to 52).
  • Zephras - Malduko Cloudcrush now respawns slightly more slowly.
Items
  • Fixed an issue with the Pouch of Violet Dust preventing players from receiving an extra hour of duration of the Camp Benefits aura as intended.
  • Fixed a bug that prevented Waylaid Crates and Craftsman’s Writs from dropping inside dungeons.
  • Berdun’s Trusty Rifle no longer has random stats and is not Bind-on-Equip.
  • Fixed a bug causing Nifty Stopwatch to share a cooldown with Dash, Blink, Sprint, and other movement abilities.
  • Zephrali Greatstaff and Fallen Dragon’s Scepter now appear correctly oriented when sheathed on the player’s back.
  • Gloves of Holy Might now work as intended.
Player versus Player
  • Removed an invisible wall that was incorrectly blocking the roof of the Alliance base in Warsong Gulch. Please be careful up there.
Quests
  • “The Monster Surfaces” quest item is now available to all players in a party.
  • “Croaky’s Head” is now available to all players in a party.
  • “Elmpaw’s Head” is now available to all players in a party.
  • Mistreating Astor Hadren during the quest “The Deathstalkers” should now properly anger him, allowing you to fight him.
  • Fixed a bug preventing Jom-jom from continuing his escape on “Jom-jom’s Escape”.
  • The door available after the quest “Ever After” should now correctly teleport players who interact with the door.
  • Fixed a bug keeping Terry Longdrink alive during the quest “Unwelcome Guests”.
  • Fixed an issue where the quest “Find Bingles” was incorrectly categorized in Ironforge, rather than Loch Modan.
  • Updated Skonk’s list to be readable by everyone going on “A Quick Grocery Run”.
  • Henrig Lonebrow’s Journal now respawns more quickly, so that more players can get started on “Lonebrow’s Journal”. It has also moved slightly down the road. Look for a similar skeleton to mark the location.
  • Addressed an issue that could prevent players from looting Berard’s Journal from Berard’s Bookshelf for “A Recipe for Death”.
  • Resolved an issue preventing completion of “Fetch ‘n’ Fletch”.
  • Fixed an issue where restarting the Rogue quest “Mission: Possible not Probable” was much less possible than intended.
  • Resolved an issue where Jezap Jinglesprocket could fail to provide players a “Bloodmaster’s Ring”.
  • Fixed an issue during the quest “Feathers in Flight” where players below level 60 could not loot the Hyjal Owl Nests.
Races
  • Tauren
    • Cultivation now correctly only goes on cooldown after completing the cast.
World
  • Lowered the population of players in various zones where there was significant congestion.
    • Developers’ notes: We’ve made this an even bigger change on the PvP ruleset, following feedback from players that they felt overcrowded in several places. We will continue to monitor how zones feel and make further adjustments as necessary.
  • Resolved an issue where the flight path from Camp Taurajo to Thunder Bluff could unintentionally go through objects.
November 6, 2026

Classes
  • Fixed an issue with the Quick and the Dead Legacy Talent where it sometimes did not work as intended.
  • Cooldown Manager
    • The Cooldown Manager will now correctly display the duration of crowd control spells at all times, even when diminishing returns or mechanic reductions (like orc stun reduction) are factors.
  • Druid
    • Bloom will now correctly heal the target.
    • Fixed a bug where the tooltip of Bear Form claimed an incorrect health value increase. The functionality was correct, but the wrong value was reported.
    • The tooltip for Ravage reported an incorrect value for its damage, and the tooltip has been corrected. There was no change made to damage done.
    • Fixed the tooltip for Swiftmend to no longer incorrectly mention consuming the effect.
  • Mage
    • Fixed an issue where Mages were still learning the Research spell and then losing it upon relogging. This spell should not exist, and you should only have the Study spell after completing the relevant quest.
    • Fixed an issue with Arcane Blast where its duration was not properly 18 seconds.
  • Rogue
    • Shank will now display Rank 1 and Rank 2 in the tooltips.
    • While Boot Knife is talented, Shank will now correctly display the number of Combo Points it grants.
  • Warlock
    • Voidwalker base health increased by about 40 at all levels.
    • The Soul Siphon talent no longer incorrectly causes Wrack to increase its own damage.
  • Warrior
    • Fixed the tooltip for Reckless Swings to mention that it activates Gore Drinker.
Dungeons
  • Fixed an issue that would prevent Zaetar’s Spirit from spawning after defeating Princess Theradras in Maraudon.
  • Fixed an issue that could cause some creatures inside Blackmaw Hold and The Drowned City to erroneously disengage.
  • The instance portal should now correctly teleport you inside The Drowned City
Enemies and NPCs
  • Dun Morogh - Fixed an issue where the troggs in Grol’bolar Quarry would respawn too quickly.
  • Durotar - Ridgeshade Lurkers now correctly have loot.
  • Riverglades - Krek the Noxious now has correct loot when defeated.
  • Swamp of Sorrows - Fixed an issue where Pelluk would sometimes not spawn.
  • Teldrassil - Fixed an issue where Lasher Sproutlings, Blooming Lashers, and Wrathvine were immune to nature damage.
Items
  • Searing Dagger is now only activated by spells that have a damaging component.
Professions
  • Leatherworking
    • Tanning Rack skill requirement lowered to 125 (was 140). This prevents it from being an obstacle to crafting various Leatherworking patterns that require 125 skill. Tanning Rack skill-ups lowered by 15 skill points to account for this.
Quests
  • Resolved an issue with the quest “Vorsha the Lasher” rudely lashing everyone in the zone.
  • Brewed a fresh pot of Darnassus’s finest coffee for Kerlonian Evershade so he falls asleep less often during “The Sleeper Has Awakened”. Players now also start with the Horn of Awakening item to wake him up when needed.
  • The quest “Rough Wolf Pelts” is now automatically cancelled if you unlearn the Skinning skill.
  • Resolved an issue with “Rediscovering the Light” where players were sometimes unable to heal NPCs.
  • Fixed an issue during the quest “Ammo for Rumbleshot” where players could not see loot if interacting immediately following another player.
  • Resolved an issue where some quest item drops in Riverglades were not shared by players in a party.
  • “Never Saddle on Quality” spawns and quest item drops should now be more plentiful.
  • The Abomimable Head dropped from The Baron in the Ruins of Lordaeron dungeon will now properly offer the quest “Unending Torment” for Horde players at level 15 (was level 16).
  • Damp Note drop rate increased. Eww.
Races
  • Night Elf
    • Fixed a bug granting Shadowmelded Druids access to Ravage and Pounce.
  • Orc
    • Fixes an issue where some Warlock pet abilities were benefitting too much from the Orc Command racial ability.
World
  • Deployed some improvements to the visibility of other players and their targets across relatively large distances.
  • Thunder Bluff - Fixed an issue where the Barbershop was darker than intended. We moooved the lights around.
November 5, 2026

Enemies and NPCs
  • Durotar - Fixed an issue where Yarrog Baneshadow was respawning more slowly than intended.
  • Zephras - Lotheluum Starbreeze now offers training to Druids as expected.
  • Dustwallow Marsh - Fixed an issue where some murlocs in Dustwallow Marsh were respawning too quickly.
  • Swamp of Sorrows - Fixed an issue where Pelluk would sometimes not spawn.
Items
  • Fixed an issue where trade supply vendors on Zephras Isle didn’t sell apprentice tradeskill bags.
  • Mild Spices now sell to vendors for 1 copper each (was 2 copper).
Player versus Player
  • Fixed an issue where Plainsrunning could be stacked in a battleground’s preparation phase.
  • Plainsrunning can no longer stack and stacks will be cancelled when carrying a flag in a battleground.
Quests
  • Fixed an issue with incorrect text in “The Sisterhood of Elune”.
  • Deathstalker Erland respawns much more quickly for the quest “Escorting Erland”.

title.en: Blizzard Made Character Creation on Higher Population Faction Increasingly Difficult
title.es: Blizzard hizo que la creación de personajes en la facción de la población superior fuera cada vez más difícil

summary.en: Blizzard Made Character Creation on Higher Population Faction Increasingly Difficult...
summary.es: Blizzard hizo que la creación de personajes en la facción de la población superior fuera cada vez más difícil...

contentHtml:
To maintain faction balance on PvP servers, Blizzard has adjusted their character creation system and it will become increasingly more difficult to create a character on the more populated faction.

Blizzard wants to maintain as close to a 50/50 faction balance as possible on PvP realms, and is making it harder to create characters on the more populated faction. While realms are at worst a 55/45 split, they want them closer. The more populated faction in each region is:
  • Horde on PvP NA
  • Alliance on EU RPPVP
Blizzard
View Original
It’s vitally important that the PvP rulesets in WoW: Forever have balanced factions where both factions vie for supremacy, creating memories of epic victories and stunning defeats that we all remember for years to come. While even the most extreme case in a region is currently at roughly a 55/45 split, that is not as close as we want it to be.

To better set the stage for the neck-and-neck conflicts we all want, we’ve adjusted the character creation system to better recognize the overall state of faction balance in each region’s PvP rulesets, rather than what may feel like snapshots of points in time. Our goal is to bring things as close to a 50/50 faction balance as possible.

In the short term, that means that it will become increasingly difficult to create characters on the more populous faction in each region – currently Horde on North American PvP rulesets or Alliance in EU Roleplay-PvP. As everyone settles and shifts, these may flip to the other side. We recognize that while restrictions are in place, it can be frustrating to not be able to start playing a specific faction in that moment, but this is a necessary trade-off for the long-term health of the ruleset, especially early on when guilds are being established and rivalries developed.

World of Warcraft: Forever’s PvP is at its best when the Alliance and Horde are on equal footing, and we are dedicated to helping maintain that balance so that we can all witness battles at the epic scale that has made WoW Forever PvP so memorable thus far.

summary.es: Nivele más rápido con su cómodo saco de dormir en WoW: Forever...

contentHtml:
The Cozy Sleeping Bag in World of Warcraft: Forever is a quest chain that takes you traveling all around Azeroth. It gives good experience as you go, but the primary draw is that the final stage rewards the Cozy Sleeping Bag. Some players may have been familiar with this quest chain from Season of Discovery, but now that Forever is released, there's no better time to grab a sleeping bag and get cozy.


Cozy Sleeping Bag
Item Level 40
Binds when picked up
Unique
Use: Unfurl a sleeping bag. Resting inside for at least one minute will provide a bonus to experience earned, stacking up to 3 times. (1 Hour Cooldown)
"Old, but still good"
Sell Price: 17 17



Collecting the Cozy Sleeping Bag may sound like a bit of a chore that could be skipped, but when you are viewing the path ahead to level 60, it really is a detour you should take sooner rather than later.


Alliance Route Directions Horde Route Directions


As Alliance, getting the sleeping bag takes approximately 89 minutes. Horde are coming in a little slower at approximately 103 minutes; this is due to the third step being closer to Alliance's second step (Horde have to go Barrens > Westfall > Stonetalon, while Alliance goes Westfall > Barrens > Stonetalon).

You can find the quest starting points below, or you can follow our full guide here.

Alliance

 Location

Westfall, Alexston Farmstead
/way 37 50
Burned-Out Remains in the Rubble of Cart Wreckage
Tip: Click map to zoom
Westfall

Horde

 Location

The Barrens, South of Camp Taurajo
/way 46 74
Burned-Out Remains in the Rubble of the Burnt Tower
Tip: Click map to zoom
The Barrens


Our Experience Calculator has been updated to include the 3% Well-Rested buff, and assuming you were to only kill mobs your own level between level 50 and 60, this tiny 3% buff to experience actually saves you the job of 162 kills, which adds up quickly. You can also combine this with the 5% Well-Fed Experience buff that you get from some Foods.

title.en: Blizzard Buffs Dungeon Enemy Experience Gains
title.es: Ganancias de experiencia enemiga en mazmorras de Blizzard Mejoras

summary.en: Blizzard Buffs Dungeon Enemy Experience Gains...
summary.es: Blizzard Mejoras Mazmorra Enemy Experience gana...

contentHtml:
Blizzard has just buffed the experience gains from dungeon creatures by a massive 50%.

After the dungeon changes buffed experience from dungeon quests and nerfed dungeon experience from mobs, many players adopted a one-and-done strategy for dungeons. Players felt like it was not worth their time to do it again, since the majority of the experience was from the quests themselves. With this hotfix, it won't feel as bad to run a dungeon again if your friends need help.
Blizzard
View Original
At about 11:05 PST today, we deployed a hotfix that increased kill experience in dungeons by 50%, so it feels better to go back in for more runs.

Happy dungeon crawling, and good luck with those Deviate Hides!

title.en: Everything About WoW: Forever Raids - Joardee Interview on WoW: Forever
title.es: Todo sobre WoW: Forever Bandas - Entrevista de Joardee en WoW: Forever

summary.en: Everything About WoW: Forever Raids - Joardee Interview on WoW: Forever...
summary.es: Todo sobre WoW: Forever Bandas - Entrevista de Joardee en WoW: Forever...

contentHtml:
Joardee interviewed Josh Greenfield and Tim Jones on WoW: Forever and discussed everything about WoW: Forever's raids!

Check out Joardee on his YouTube Channel, Twitch, and Twitter.

We've summarized the key points from the interview below.

Raid Philosophy
  • Tim Jones is really excited about having different raids.
  • When we go back to Blackwing Lair and Molten Core, they want it to feel familiar but new.
  • Narratively, they plan to use those raids to mark various points in time.
  • For Season of Discovery, Scarlet Enclave was super fun and creative, but maybe too challenging.
  • They maybe pushed things too far at the end of SoD with the complexity of boss fights and tuning.
  • Will be really exciting when they can reincorporate Scarlet Enclave back into Forever down the road.
  • They want the encounters to be approachable. Somewhere in the realms of the difficulty and complexity of the Season of Mastery raids and baseline Naxx.
  • They'll be keeping the same visual language of Vanilla raids: no gigantic visual outlines on mechanics and that you don't need addons.
  • They still want there to be difficult encounters that are aspirational, whether they're at the end of the raid or secrets, that will drop gear that you can "flex" with in a capital city.
Prog Time
  • Somewhere between two to three weeks of progression for the average guild.
Raids
  • They can have creative raid encounters, hidden bosses, and secret phases.
  • Fundamentally, they only want one difficulty for their instanced content.
  • Ulduar Hard Modes are cool, but they are the start of splitting a piece of content into Normal and Heroic.
  • In TBC and Classic, everyone is competing on the same bosses.
  • There's value in a casual guild taking on the exact same encounter as the Hardcore guild.
40 Man
  • Onyxia will drop a lot of loot.
  • Onyxia turns into how few people can we kill it with to maximize loot or to showboat?
Farm
  • One of the issues with truly flat horizontal progression is that it assumes that all loot is equal. Then if you're in Tier 4, there are four tiers and people still want something from the first raid.
  • Aggrend thinks that this is why they won't have purely flat item level progression.
  • Maybe on a free raid day, you might go back and clear Hyjal to "get your healers their Legendary Staff" a couple patches in.
  • Hyjal has multiple wings and you want to target a specific boss for loot, you can.
  • In future patches, there could be shortcuts for the raid, such as the Translocation Orb in Naxx.
  • It's important that people go through the intended progression path when it's the active tier, but allowing people to target farm things later to respect people's time later on farm
Chase Items
  • They've made an effort to make sure there are items of great power that are on various bosses.
Raid Progression
  • If everyone is kitted out, then you can probably have some carries.
  • Ideally, they've tuned stuff in a way where it requires players to do the previous tier.

title.en: The Darkmoon Faire is Coming To Elwynn Forest First in WoW: Forever
title.es: The Darkmoon Faire llegará a Elwynn Forest por primera vez en WoW: Forever

summary.en: The Darkmoon Faire is Coming To Elwynn Forest First in WoW: Forever...
summary.es: The Darkmoon Faire llegará a Elwynn Forest por primera vez en WoW: Forever...

contentHtml:
The iconic Darkmoon Faire event will be making its first stop in WoW Forever in Elwynn Forest, giving the Alliance the first home-field advantage to the event.

 


Players in Elwynn can see the Faire being set up, and the in-game calendar lets all players know the fair will be active on Monday, with the event going on for one week.

 


The Darkmoon Faire has fun mini games, reputation farms, and rare items to obtain, but one of its most iconic purposes in Classic WoW was obtaining the powerful world buff: Sayge's Dark Fortune of Damage, giving players a 10% damage buff for 2 hours. We've learned that World Buffs in Forever will not work the same way they did in Classic, as they won't be allowed in raids, but will still work in the open world.

Tweet #2099230107147931731


With this being the first Darkmoon Faire of Forever, we don't yet know if there are any new surprises in store. We'll have to wait and see once the Faire goes live if any new Forever flair has been added.
